bio.text: Cottie Petrie-Norris represents California's 73rd Assembly District, which covers the cities of Costa Mesa, Irvine and Tustin; she was elected to the State Assembly in 2018.

She chairs the Assembly Committee on Utilities and Energy and also serves on the committees for Budget; Economic Development, Growth, and Household Impact; Insurance; and Privacy and Consumer Protection.
